# Codex fixtures

**Constructed, not captured. Pending review.** No Codex account was available (decided 2026-11-08), so these payloads were built from the Codex hook documentation of 2026-11-08 and from Codex CLI 0.167.0's behaviour without a login (spike S5). Field names follow the documentation. Tool names (`shell`, `apply_patch`, `mcp__server__tool`), values, and the rollout path are illustrative. Replace them with captured payloads, sanitized, as soon as someone with Codex access can record a session.

File names follow `<HookEvent>[-variant].json`. `PreToolUse.json` exists only to prove that the plugin ignores it (CAP-2).
